description: List the Nema by Anahana digital products on sale right now (for example angel-number guides and a personalized natal chart report). Each product has its sku, name, type (free_lead_magnet, one_time or bundle), language, list price and currency (e.g. "11.11" and "USD"), and url: the product's page on anahana.com, the only place to buy it. Paid products also carry checkout_note. Read-only: this server has no checkout or payment tool and never returns a payment link. The list is the site's own catalog, regenerated on every site deploy. Use get_product for one product.

language.description: Only products in this language, e.g. "en". One code, a comma-separated list, or "all". Omit to list every product on sale, in every language.

name: list_products
title: List the Anahana products on sale
